description: SELECT type, name, tbl_name, sql FROM sqlite_master ORDER BY name over a database every store has initialised. `sql` is the statement text as SQLite stores it.

rows.name: auth_secrets
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_secrets (
  name          TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  value         TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT

rows.name: auth_sessions
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_sessions (
  id              TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  token_sha256    BLOB    NOT NULL,
  label           TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at_ms   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at_ms   INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_seen_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT

rows.name: auth_sessions_expiry
rows.sql: CREATE INDEX auth_sessions_expiry ON auth_sessions(expires_at_ms)

rows.name: auth_throttle
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE auth_throttle (
  scope           TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  failures        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_failed_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  locked_until_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT

rows.name: auth_throttle_last_failed
rows.sql: CREATE INDEX auth_throttle_last_failed ON auth_throttle(last_failed_ms)

rows.name: automation_jobs
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE automation_jobs (
  id               TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  name             TEXT    NOT NULL,
  schedule_json    TEXT    NOT NULL,
  payload_json     TEXT    NOT NULL,
  enabled          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  delete_after_run INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  next_run_at_ms   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_run_at_ms   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_status      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  last_error       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  run_count        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at_ms    INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at_ms    INTEGER NOT NULL,
  -- Who asked for this, when it was not a person. Empty is the operator, which
  -- is the common case, so these default rather than being nullable: a job the
  -- panel made and a job whose agent has been forgotten are the same row shape.
  created_by_agent   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_by_session TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
) STRICT

rows.name: automation_jobs_due
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX automation_jobs_due
  ON automation_jobs(next_run_at_ms ASC, id ASC)
  WHERE enabled = 1 AND next_run_at_ms > 0

rows.name: automation_runs
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE automation_runs (
  id             TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  job_id         TEXT    NOT NULL REFERENCES automation_jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  started_at_ms  INTEGER NOT NULL,
  finished_at_ms INTEGER,
  status         TEXT    NOT NULL,
  skip_reason    TEXT,
  error          TEXT,
  output         TEXT,
  warnings_json  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
  session_key    TEXT
) STRICT

rows.name: automation_runs_job
rows.sql:
CREATE INDEX automation_runs_job
  ON automation_runs(job_id, started_at_ms DESC, id ASC)

rows.name: extension_approvals
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE extension_approvals (
  id             TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  digest         TEXT    NOT NULL,
  approved_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT

rows.name: messages
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE messages (
  id            TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  session_key   TEXT    NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(key) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  seq           INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  turn_id       TEXT,
  role          TEXT    NOT NULL,
  payload_json  TEXT    NOT NULL
) STRICT

rows.name: messages_session_seq
rows.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX messages_session_seq ON messages(session_key, seq)

rows.name: messages_turn
rows.sql: CREATE INDEX messages_turn ON messages(session_key, turn_id)

rows.name: notifications
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE notifications (
  id            TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  title         TEXT    NOT NULL,
  body          TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  level         TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'info',
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  read_at_ms    INTEGER,
  session_key   TEXT,
  job_id        TEXT
) STRICT

rows.name: notifications_created
rows.sql: CREATE INDEX notifications_created ON notifications(created_at_ms DESC, id ASC)

rows.name: notifications_unread
rows.sql: CREATE INDEX notifications_unread ON notifications(created_at_ms DESC) WHERE read_at_ms IS NULL

rows.name: sessions
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE sessions (
  key                   TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  title                 TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  origin                TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'web',
  agent_id              TEXT,
  workspace_id          TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default',
  created_at_ms         INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at_ms         INTEGER NOT NULL,
  metadata_json         TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  next_seq              INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1
) STRICT

rows.name: sessions_updated
rows.sql: CREATE INDEX sessions_updated ON sessions(updated_at_ms DESC)

rows.name: sessions_workspace
rows.sql: CREATE INDEX sessions_workspace ON sessions(workspace_id, updated_at_ms DESC)

rows.name: toolbox_approvals
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE toolbox_approvals (
  name           TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  manifest_sha256 TEXT   NOT NULL,
  image          TEXT    NOT NULL,
  approved_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL
) STRICT

rows.name: turn_stats
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE turn_stats (
  turn_id           TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  session_key       TEXT    NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(key) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  agent_id          TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  workspace_id      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default',
  provider          TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  model             TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  started_at_ms     INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ended_at_ms       INTEGER NOT NULL,
  iterations        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  stop_reason       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  prompt_tokens     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  completion_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  total_tokens      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  cached_tokens     INTEGER,
  reasoning_tokens  INTEGER,
  generation_ms     INTEGER,
  generation_tokens INTEGER,
  first_token_ms    INTEGER,
  error             TEXT
) STRICT

rows.name: turn_stats_session
rows.sql: CREATE INDEX turn_stats_session ON turn_stats(session_key, ended_at_ms DESC)

rows.name: workspaces
rows.sql:
CREATE TABLE workspaces (
  id            TEXT    PRIMARY KEY,
  name          TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
  is_default    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  metadata_json TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
) STRICT

rows.name: workspaces_default
rows.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX workspaces_default ON workspaces(is_default) WHERE is_default = 1
